keyFindings: Original208 tree01 and tree01_re both derive64native units perU despite bothPNGs64x64; repeated roots spaced32native whilecanonicalpaintedcrown42native. Do not blindly halve canonicalcrown width.
Context93 must join source canopy/lower-stump quads at their same repeated U-column centers; removing onlystandingcards leaves native stalk/stump remnants.
Context88 is already authored multipart3D tree art, including actual trunk textures and horizontal canopy/ground faces. Parallel guard rejection is not by itself a defect.
Context13 bush_a andcontext8 tree_ki select specific atlasregions; globalPNGboundingboxes cannot define their root count, width or palette region.
Context92 crown cards lack _un-named ground anchors; separate bf_tree02 material supplies source stumps at lower nativeheight.

Several ordinaryleaf families use groundmaterialprefixes that differ from treeFamily normalization (hu_tree01_un, green_un_lm1, treekn versus tree01_un); root joins need actual identity/geometry rather than presumed matchingname.
